title: Lamb Stew in Chinese Style
description: A hearty and flavorful lamb stew inspired by Chinese cuisine. This dish is perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: Silky
ingredients.notes: Use a mixture of hoisin sauce and soy sauce

ingredients.name: Kissed
ingredients.notes: Use sesame oil for a distinct flavor

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of sesame oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb cubes in batches until browned on all sides. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the remaining 2 tbsp of sesame oil to the pot, then add the Russian Stew and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the browned lamb back into the pot and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Silky and 2 cups of water. Pour the mixture into the pot and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let stew for 1.5 hours or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped green onions if desired.
